name: Renjou Sayaka
source: The charismatic founder of the Three Stars Club (☆☆☆部, ほしみつぶ). After crossing paths with Masanobu and guiding him through the town, fate brings them together as classmates. Sayaka's passion lies in photography, capturing the beauty of her beloved city, Tonan. Known for her friendly nature and extensive network, she eagerly lends a helping hand to those in need. Despite that, she is perceived as a problematic student by the school chairman herself, Kujou Hatsune.
